decision_record.transfer: The sleeve's designed edge is computed on completed bars (desk convention, sleeves/momentum.py last_completed); a forming bar is a partial, revisable print — decisions taken on it pay real spread/slippage for a signal that may not exist at the close.
decision_record.comparison: Same-pass paired A/B: treatment (completed bars only) vs shadow control (untrimmed view) evaluated on identical opportunities in a throwaway state dir; control intents never emitted.
decision_record.mechanism: compute_features, stop-breach and trail checks read bars[-1]; the spec is close-based ('trail breach at close vs 10MA'), so a forming bar's partial close can force a stop exit before the close exists.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture A/B: held 10 @ 100 (stop falls back to entry), 30 completed bars at 100, forming bar at 85. Control: 1 stop-breach exit. Treatment: no exit.
decision_record.experiment: tests/test_harden_edge_batch17_blockers.py: control cases reproduce pre-change behavior (switch OFF), treatment cases assert the changed decision; fail-first proven (4 treatment failures on pre-cure tree, 2026-10-24).
